title: Sign in with ChatGPT
description: You can now sign in to Conductor with your ChatGPT account and run Codex on your ChatGPT plan.

blocks.html: We're excited to be partnering with OpenAI on Sign in with ChatGPT.
You can now bring your ChatGPT plan to Conductor in a few clicks. Go to Settings → Agents → Codex and click Continue with ChatGPT to start using your Codex plan in Conductor.

blocks.alt: Continue with ChatGPT on the Conductor sign-in page

blocks.html: For new users: when you create an account, choose "Continue with ChatGPT" to bring your ChatGPT identity and plan to Conductor. Codex will then use your plan with no API key or codex login. If you've already set up Codex another way, Conductor keeps your setup.
Download Conductor and give it a try.
